UpdateStageDescription: Check and install Git, Git LFS, and Java 11 if missing
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; echo '=== 2009Scape Prerequisites ==='; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Git missing → installing...'; (sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq git) || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq git) || echo 'WARNING: Could not install Git'; else echo 'Git OK'; fi; if ! command -v git-lfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Git LFS missing → installing...'; (sudo apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs) || (apt-get install -y -qq git-lfs) || echo 'WARNING: Could not install Git LFS'; else echo 'Git LFS OK'; fi; git lfs install || true; JAVA11=false; if command -v java >/dev/null 2>&1; then VER=$(java -version 2>&1 | head -n1); echo Found: $VER; if echo \"$VER\" | grep -q 'version \"11'; then JAVA11=true; fi; fi; if [ \"$JAVA11\" = false ]; then echo 'Java 11 not found → trying install...'; if command -v getamp >/dev/null 2>&1; then getamp installJava || echo 'getamp installJava failed'; else (sudo apt-get install -y -qq temurin-11-jdk) || (apt-get install -y -qq openjdk-11-jdk) || echo 'WARNING: Could not install Java 11'; fi; else echo 'Java 11 OK'; fi; echo '=== Prerequisites finished ==='"

UpdateStageDescription: Clone or update the 2009Scape source from GitLab
Pull LFS files and compile the server with Maven, then place jar in builddir
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; echo '=== Git LFS + Build ==='; cd 2009scape; git lfs install; git lfs pull; echo 'Running Maven build...'; cd Server; chmod +x mvnw; export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/temurin-11-jdk-amd64; export PATH=\"$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH\"; ./mvnw clean package -DskipTests; echo 'Locating jar...'; mkdir -p ../builddir; JAR=$(find target -name '*-jar-with-dependencies.jar' -o -name 'server*.jar' 2>/dev/null | head -n1); if [ -z \"$JAR\" ]; then echo 'ERROR: No jar found in target/'; ls -la target/ || true; exit 1; fi; echo Copying $JAR to ../builddir/server.jar; cp -f \"$JAR\" ../builddir/server.jar; ls -la ../builddir/; echo '=== LFS + Build finished ==='"
